probe_budget_note: The generated-token cap is our proposed pilot limit, not a published limit. Record observed calls, sequences, tokens, wall time, and cost. Smaller limits are a methodological deviation.
edit_fraction_note: A proposed 0.1 percent ceiling, not a target or the paper's realized edit fraction. Compute counts over the complete original checkpoint and report text-only and whole-checkpoint denominators separately where applicable.
controls: unchanged weights with model-card thinking sampling
identity edit through the complete save/reload pipeline
edited weights under the same sampling as the matched base
